Features · Nomi 2.5

Built for parallel agents and local control

Unified workspace, multi-tab side workspace, 4-protocol local gateway and safety boundaries in one lightweight native app.

Agent Board Side Workspace Models & Gateway Knowledge & MCP Sandbox & Character
01 · Agent Board

Parallel scheduling with automatic memory protection

See Nomi conversations, background tasks, dispatched agents and your external terminal or IDE sessions (read-only) on one board. Cards needing approval rise to the top.

  • Live status, project folder, CPU and memory footprint on every card
  • Three concurrency profiles (Saver / Balanced / Full) keep machine load in check
  • Memory guard automatically pauses background agents under pressure and resumes in place
Read Agent Board docs →
Agent BoardOpen full size
02 · Multi-Tab Side Workspace

Review diffs, inspect traces and run terminals side by side

Manage Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok, dsh, Kimi Code and MiniMax Code in one unified sidebar, resume external CLI sessions, and open the side workspace whenever you need code review or tools.

  • Collapsible step stream plus dockable Run Trace tabs (graph, timeline & thinking)
  • Side-by-side Diff review, per-turn undo and drag-and-drop @path file mentions
  • Built-in split interactive terminal, native embedded browser view and side chat
Explore Agents →
Side WorkspaceOpen full size
03 · Models & Local Gateway

Translate 4 protocols locally — configure models once

Add an official, third-party or local provider once under Settings → Models & Agents and assign it by task or cost tier. Transient disconnects retry on the exact same model without silent swaps.

  • Translates Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Responses, Chat Completions and Gemini protocols
  • Preserves streaming, tool calling, reasoning traces, images and compaction
  • Supports nomi://provider/* web import links with mandatory confirmation dialog
Read gateway design →
Models & AgentsOpen full size
04 · Knowledge Base & Extensions

Cited folder Q&A, editable memory & visual MCP

Index local folders for answers with clickable file citations, manage long-term memories transparently, and configure MCP servers and SKILL.md packs via UI.

  • Import existing MCP configs from Claude Code, Cursor and other tools
  • View, edit, clear or export your profile and long-term memories at any time
  • Optional "local models only for file reading" guard keeps sensitive docs offline
Explore Knowledge & MCP docs →
Knowledge & MemoryOpen full size
05 · Safety Boundaries & Optional Mascot

Protect local credentials by default; character optional

macOS system sandbox isolates agents from SSH keys, cloud tokens and .env files by default. Risky commands pass secondary review — and the desktop character stays off unless you enable it.

  • Five per-session permission modes from Plan-only to Allow all
  • External-content taint tracking requires confirmation after web or MCP reads
  • Optional transparent desktop character with bubbles, file-drop summary and voice
Read privacy & security docs →
